items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: But most of Joe and Buddy Betteen was derby, you see?

ctx.x: Yeah, you see, that's what Joe liked. Then, late years, he started using his mute. But most of Joe and Buddy Betteen was derby, you see? Yeah. It gives a better effect, you know? Oh, yeah, yeah.
Not the ten derby, the real derby. The real, real derby.
